mcqs.question: Which agency forecast India’s GDP growth at 7.4%?
mcqs.explanation: The NSO forecast India’s GDP growth at 7.4%. ICRA and ADB also gave forecasts, but their figures were 7.4% and 7.2%, respectively; Grant Thornton’s forecast was 7.3–7.5%.

mcqs.question: Which agency forecast India’s GDP growth at 7.4% among the following?
mcqs.explanation: ICRA forecast India’s GDP growth at 7.4%. ADB’s forecast was 7.2%, while Grant Thornton gave a range of 7.3–7.5%.

mcqs.question: Which agency forecast India’s GDP growth at 7.2%?
mcqs.explanation: ADB forecast India’s GDP growth at 7.2%. NSO and ICRA forecast 7.4%, while Grant Thornton’s forecast was 7.3–7.5%.

mcqs.keyword: GDP forecast and world GDP rank
mcqs.question:
With reference to the February 2026 economic forecasts and the share in world GDP during 1980–2023, consider the following statements:
1. Grant Thornton forecast India’s GDP growth at 7.3–7.5%.
2. India ranked fourth in the share of world GDP during 1980–2023.
How many of the above statements are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Only one statement is correct. Grant Thornton forecast India’s GDP growth at 7.3–7.5%; India ranked fifth, not fourth, in the share of world GDP during 1980–2023.
